executive_summary: Episode 104 presents a White House Military Office email allegedly sent at 9:49 PM ET on the night of the alleged shooting, recommending amplification of Erika Kirk's 'I want to go home' video. The White House allegedly attempted to rescind the email and ordered recipients to delete it. Names on the email include Steven Cheung, Ryan Ripian, and Gustav Anderly (WHCA). Justin Streiff's role as COO 7 days before Charlie's death, his call to a book printer, his ties to Winning Team Publishing (Sergio Gor/Don Jr.), and the alleged $10M missing from Turning Point Action are advanced. Sergio Gor's ambassador-to-India move and Erika's ceremony appearance are connected. Nick Shirley defense via Jessica Reed Krauss tweets and Macron slap Times headline also covered.

nodes.name: Sergio Gor
nodes.description: Trump-world operative and later US ambassador to India. Host ties him to Winning Team Publishing and to Susie Wiles's orbit.

nodes.name: Steven Cheung
nodes.description: White House communications aide. Named on the WHMO email CC list and in the Epstein situation-room attendee read (ASR Chung/Chong).
